triage.note: Found by the T14 per-era taxonomy diff (not by a failing run): the item set is complete for 1993 and every span is right, but three of the fourteen labels rendered over those spans are captions that did not exist in 1993. MEASURED PRE-FIX (2026-08-20, this fixture, period_end 1993-12-31): item 5 title 'Market for the Registrant's Common Stock and Related Stockholder Matters', item 12 title 'Security Ownership of Certain Beneficial Owners and Management and Related Stockholder Matters', item 13 title 'Certain Relationships and Related Transactions, and Director Independence'. Three distinct table defects, one per item: (a) segment.TITLES['5'] carries 'Common Stock' as its legacy alias, a wording that is authoritative in NO era of the form -- Form 10-K Item 5 tracks Reg S-K Item 201 (17 CFR 229.201, 'Market price of and dividends on the registrant's common equity and related stockholder matters') and reads 'Common Equity' before 2004 and after it; (b) TITLES['12'] has ONE alias, the post-2002 caption, so nothing can render the pre-2002 one; (c) TITLES['13'] likewise has one alias, the post-2006 caption. Same failure class as the pre-B audit's item-14 finding (ge-1994-oldformat.json provenance, 'the label contradicted the content'): the span is right and the name over it is a statement to the reader that the extraction is something it is not. No status, offset, warning or doc_status moves. CORRECTED (PR #17 round 1): confidence DOES move on other fixtures -- validate.score reads title_similarity, which is computed against the TITLES aliases this fix edits, so 10 spans across ba-2003, gs-2002, ibm-1997, intc-2002 and tgt-2002 go 0.75 -> 0.95 (all ten pinned now, all ten red at 0.75 against the pre-fix taxonomy). On THIS fixture nothing but the labels moves: items 12 and 13 are incorporated_by_reference, whose BASE_IBR never reads title_similarity, and item 5's confidence is unchanged. item_field remains the only check type that can see the defect here.

provenance: AUTHORED FROM THE COMMITTED FIXTURE, no new fixture: GE FY1993 10-K, EDGAR accession 0000040545-94-000003 (full public-source provenance in evals/fixtures/README.md and in ge-1994-oldformat.json). Nothing about the fixture changed; this case adds label assertions the eval vocabulary could make since the pre-B audit added item_field and no case had made for these three codes. AUTHORITY for each asserted value, in the order the checks appear: (1) Item 5 -- Reg S-K Item 201 (17 CFR 229.201) is titled 'Market price of and dividends on the registrant's common equity and related stockholder matters'; the Form 10-K caption tracks it and the phrase 'Common Stock' appears in no era of the item. (2) Item 12 -- the '...and Related Stockholder Matters' suffix arrived with the equity-compensation-plan table added by Release Nos. 33-8048 / 34-45189, 'Disclosure of Equity Compensation Plan Information' (adopted 2001-12-21, effective 2002-02-01), which registrants had to comply with in annual reports for FISCAL YEARS ENDING ON OR AFTER 2002-03-15 -- a period-end-keyed date, so no filing-date compromise is involved. (3) Item 13 -- the ', and Director Independence' suffix arrived with Release 33-8732A, 'Executive Compensation and Related Person Disclosure' (published 2006-08-11), compliance in Forms 10-K for FISCAL YEARS ENDING ON OR AFTER 2006-12-15. CORPUS CORROBORATION (independent of the releases, measured by reading each fixture's own heading_text, which is the filer's wording rather than the canon): every one of the eight committed pre-2005 fixtures writes Item 5 as 'Common Equity' (ge-1994, ibm-1997, ko-1997, textron-2001 'MARKETS FOR', intc-2002, gs-2002, tgt-2002, ba-2003) and not one writes 'Common Stock'; this fixture's own Item 12 heading reads 'Item 12. Security Ownership of Certain Beneficial Owners and Management' and its Item 13 heading reads 'Item 13. Certain Relationships and Related Transactions'. The two part checks are green before and after and are here as the guard that a title fix does not move a part: LEGACY_PART touches item 14 only, and items 12 and 13 are Part III in every era. WATCHED RED before any code change -- see the commit that adds this file. NOT tagged 'invariant': a wrong label is confined to one item's presentation and does not corrupt spans, the same reasoning that keeps fy2021-item-9c in the fast suite alone.
